title: there is / there are
grammarTitle: there is / there are — описываем что есть в доме
grammarNote:
"There is" и "there are" — это конструкции для описания того, что СУЩЕСТВУЕТ или НАХОДИТСЯ где-то. В казахском языке им соответствует "бар" (есть), в русском — "есть / имеется / находится".

В Модуле 3 мы говорили "This is my desk" — это МОЙ стол (мы показываем конкретный предмет).
Теперь мы говорим "There is a desk" — ЕСТЬ стол (мы описываем, что существует).

Сравни:
"This is my sofa." → Вот мой диван. (показываешь)
"There is a sofa in the living room." → В гостиной есть диван. (описываешь)

Главное правило:
→ THERE IS + один предмет (ед. ч.) или неисчисляемое
→ THERE ARE + несколько предметов (мн. ч.)

Примеры из квартиры Камилы:
"There IS a sofa in the living room." (один диван)
"There ARE two bookshelves near the window." (несколько полок)
"There IS some furniture in the hallway." (неисчисляемое)
"There ARE some plants on the balcony." (несколько растений)

💡 Запомни: "there" здесь не значит "там" — это грамматическая конструкция!

grammarTable.subject: There IS + ед.ч. / неисчисл.
grammarTable.example: There is a sofa. · There is a kitchen. · There is some furniture.

grammarTable.example: There are two beds. · There are some plants. · There are four chairs.

grammarTable.example: There aren't any noisy neighbours. · There aren't any curtains.

grammarTable.subject: IS there + ед.ч.?

grammarTable.example: Are there two bedrooms? · Are there any plants? · Are there any shops?

grammarExtra.title: Affirmative — утверждение: there is / there are

rows.example: "There is a comfortable sofa in the living room."
"There is some furniture in the hallway." · "There is natural light in the kitchen."
"There are two bookshelves near the window."
"There are some plants on the balcony." · "There are some books on the shelf."
"There's a sofa." = "There is a sofa." · Нет краткой формы для "there are"!

rows.form: Порядок слов: THERE + BE + предмет + место
rows.example: "There is a desk [near the window]." · "There are two beds [in the bedroom]."

grammarExtra.title: Negative — отрицание: there isn't / there aren't

rows.example: "There isn't a lift in our building." · "There isn't a bathtub — only a shower."
"There aren't any noisy neighbours." · "There aren't any curtains in the bedroom."
"There isn't any hot water today!" · "There isn't any space for a dishwasher."

rows.form: ISN'T = is not · AREN'T = are not
rows.example: "There is not a balcony." = "There isn't a balcony." (оба верны, isn't более разговорное)
❌ "There is no a sofa." → ✅ "There isn't a sofa." ИЛИ "There is no sofa." (без артикля!)
"There is no lift." · "There is no garden." · "There are no curtains." (формально)

grammarExtra.title: Questions — вопросы: Is there? / Are there?

rows.example: "Is there a balcony?" — "Yes, there is!" / "No, there isn't."
"Are there any plants?" — "Yes, there are!" / "No, there aren't."
"Is there a park nearby?" → "Yes, there IS." ❌НЕ "Yes, it is." или "Yes, there."
"How many rooms are there?" → "There are three rooms."
"How much space is there?" → "There isn't much space — it's a small apartment."
"What is there in the living room?" → "There is a sofa, a TV, and two bookshelves."

grammarExtra.title: there is/are + some / any — связь с Модулем 7

rows.example: "There is some furniture in the hallway." · "There is some hot water."
"There are some books on the shelf." · "There are some hooks on the door."
"There isn't any space for a dishwasher." · "There isn't any natural light."
"There aren't any curtains." · "There aren't any shops nearby."
"Is there any hot water?" → "Yes, there is some!" / "No, there isn't any."
"Are there any plants?" → "Yes, there are some!" / "No, there aren't any."

grammarTip:
Три шага — и ты никогда не ошибёшься с there is / there are:

① Посмотри на существительное после there is/are:
   Один предмет → THERE IS: "There IS a sofa."
   Несколько → THERE ARE: "There ARE two beds."

② Для отрицания добавь NOT:
   There IS + NOT → There ISN'T
   There ARE + NOT → There AREN'T
   "There ISN'T a dishwasher." · "There AREN'T any curtains."

③ Для вопроса переставь IS/ARE вперёд:
   IS there a balcony? (один предмет)
   ARE there any plants? (несколько)
   Краткий ответ: "Yes, there IS." / "No, there ISN'T."

🏠 Запомни через квартиру Камилы:
"There's a sofa, a TV, and two bookshelves in the living room."
"There's a washing machine but there ISN'T a dishwasher!"
"ARE there any plants? Yes, there ARE — four on the balcony!"

exercises.text: ___ a comfortable sofa in the living room.
exercises.hint: Sofa = singular → There IS a sofa.

exercises.text: ___ two single beds in the bedroom.
exercises.hint: Two beds = plural → There ARE two beds.

exercises.text: Kamila's apartment is small. ___ a lift in the building.
exercises.hint: Singular (a lift) → There ISN'T a lift.

exercises.text: "Are there a sofa in the living room?" is correct English.
exercises.hint: Sofa is singular → "IS there a sofa?" Not "are there a sofa".
Plants = plural → ARE there any plants?
Short answer: Yes, there IS. (never "Yes, it is.")

opts: There are some plants on the balcony.
Is there any sofa in the room?
exercises.correct: There are some plants on the balcony.
exercises.hint: "There are SOME plants" ✅ — plants = plural. Others have grammar errors.

exercises.text: "How many rooms are there in Kamila's apartment?" — ___
exercises.hint: "How many rooms ARE THERE?" → "There ARE three rooms." (plural → are)
